evidence.section: 3.2 Relative density and phase composition of the TNZM alloys
evidence.quote: the SA0 alloy exclusively contains the β-phase, indicating that the elements Nb, Zr, and Mn have dissolved in the Ti matrix to form a BCC solid solution after SPS sintering.
